title: Canonical graded quotient map and induced coordinate quotient immersion
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $N\geq0$. Give $B=k[z_0,\ldots,z_N]$ its standard total-degree grading, let $J$ be a homogeneous ideal, and give the actual quotient $A=B/J$ the image grading $A_m=q(B_m)$ of [def-sfb-coordinate-quotient-grading]. The canonical graded quotient homomorphism $q_J:B\to A$ is the actual ring quotient map $b\mapsto b\bmod J$, with its degree-preserving structure supplied by these image submodules. Define the canonical coordinate quotient morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] $j_J:\operatorname{Proj}(A)\to\operatorname{Proj}(B)$ [def-pc-proj] to be the Proj morphism induced by $q_J$. The irrelevant-ideal condition for this Proj map is supplied by the surjectivity of the quotient homomorphism. This construction imposes no saturation or properness condition on $J$, and includes $J=B$ and the zero quotient.

source.place: Tag 01N0, lemma-surjective-graded-rings-map-proj, applied to the actual homogeneous quotient; Tag 03GL, lemma-closed-in-projective-space, for its coordinate application. The quotient grading is Algebra, Tag 00JL.
